subject: Replacing REDIS_STATIC with static (#691)
reason: The change only renames the REDIS_STATIC macro to the literal keyword static in src/quicklist.c and removes the now-unused -DREDIS_STATIC=''/-DSERVER_STATIC='' definitions from the Makefiles. quicklist.c's fallback already defined REDIS_STATIC as static (the Makefile defined SERVER_STATIC, a different symbol, and Lua's sources never reference REDIS_STATIC), so every affected function was compiled with identical static linkage before and after. No runtime behaviour, reply, encoding, persistence or replication path changes; it is a pure build/refactor change that needs no scenario.
